snippets: Developed a multi-tenant app in React and Redux that allowed teachers in the UAE to create and sell courses across the world from a clean admin panel.
Added a marketplace for teachers to sell their courses at and for parents to buy courses from.
Created a course creator tool that teachers could use to create courses using drag and drop elements.
Created a meeting tool that allowed teachers to conduct online sessions with their students.
Built a design system in Bootstrap and Storybook as an NPM package for the tools to share.
